requirements.quote: CONDUIT BELOW GRADE TO BE NON-METALLIC AND CONCRETE ENCASED.
requirements.text: Conduits below grade must be non-metallic and encased in concrete.

requirements.quote: PROVIDE NEW CONDUIT DUCT BANK CONSISTING OF (4) 4" CONDUITS. CONNECT TO EXISTING CONDUIT
requirements.text: Install a new conduit duct bank with four 4-inch conduits and connect to existing conduit.

requirements.quote: DUCT BANK AT LOCATION INDICATED. CONTRACTOR TO VERIFY IN FIELD LOCATION OF END OF DUCT
requirements.text: Verify the location of the duct bank end in the field.

requirements.quote: PROVIDE (2) 4" CONDUITS FOR POWER CONNECTION FROM SWITCHGEAR IN SWITCHGEAR BUILDING TO LOCATION INDICATED AND STUB & CAP CONDUITS FOR CONNECTION IN FUTURE PHASE. SEE SHEETS +000 Col Eileen Collins Bivd
requirements.text: Install two 4-inch conduits for power connection from the switchgear to the specified location, and stub and cap for future use.
